page_title: TOT 3-1 SOU | Tottenham Hotspur v Southampton 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Aaron Ramsdale gets a hand on the penalty from Mathys Tel (Tottenham), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
90+6' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+5' The referee points to the penalty spot. Tottenham are awarded a penalty kick!

90+5' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Welington (Southampton). Michael Salisbury saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. The referee blows his whistle and awards Tottenham a penalty after chaos inside the box.

90' 2 - 1 Kamaldeen Sulemana sends a lovely ball into Mateus Fernandes (Southampton). He latches on to it and shoots inside the right post from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the bottom left corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is alert and denies him.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mathys Tel (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch for Dominic Solanke.
85' CLOSE! Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
83' Here is a change. Lesley Ugochukwu is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Ross Stewart (Southampton).
82' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
82' PENALTY APPEAL after Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
80' That's the end of the game for James Maddison (Tottenham), who is replaced by Yves Bissouma.
80' Substitution. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) will be replaced by Archie Gray.
79' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
73' Ivan Juric has decided to make a change. Paul Onuachu (Southampton) replaces Cameron Archer.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Tyler Dibling as he is replaced by Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton).
71' The attendance is 60984.
70' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Tottenham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' A snap shot by Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Aaron Ramsdale produces a good save to thwart him.
64' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Welington (Southampton) replacing Ryan Manning.
64' A substitution has been made. Joe Aribo goes off and William Smallbone (Southampton) comes on.
63' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) and blew his whistle. A free kick to Tottenham.
62' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' The Southampton players are exchanging some short passes.
57' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Rodrigo Bentancur and he is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Heung-Min Son trots off the pitch and is replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).

55' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
53' Tottenham are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
49' Southampton fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
49' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+8' Djed Spence (Tottenham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Aaron Ramsdale makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.

45+7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Southampton, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

45+6' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
45+5' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+2' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
42' 2 - 0 Goal! James Maddison gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 2:0.
39' The goal by Tottenham won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
35' The Tottenham players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
34' Goal! Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 2:0.
29' Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Looks like Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
27' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Aaron Ramsdale into a superb diving save to keep it out.
26' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
25' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. That's a free kick to Southampton.
22' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Michael Salisbury had a clear view and blows his whistle.
22' The resulting corner, taken by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), comes to nothing.
21' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
21' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham). The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
19' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
18' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham have a free kick from a promising distance.
16' Southampton have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
13' 1 - 0 Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches on to a pass and finds himself in a great position inside the box before unleashing a stunning effort into the top left corner.

13' This was a nice effort by both teams. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) connected with a cross from the side and slammed it straight towards the left side of the target. Guglielmo Vicario leapt like a salmon and tipped the ball onto the post.
12' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Aaron Ramsdale makes a save.
12' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
11' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
10' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) will deliver the corner kick.
10' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
9' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
5' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Southampton.
4' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
3' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
2' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
1' James Maddison (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Tottenham will take a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Tottenham will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Salisbury.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
